name: INO
mood: clinical jewelry gallery in paper white
summary: A quiet jewelry-gallery commerce style with white canvas, black micro type, pale product fields, Sequel100Wide at one weight, tiny uppercase labels, zero-padded product cards, small 4px utility controls, and bottom navigation with circle indicators.

typography.fallback: Eurostile Extended, Neue Haas Grotesk Display, Inter Tight, Arial

layout.model: white gallery canvas with pale product fields, zero-padded product cards, sparse metadata, and bottom navigation with circle indicators

elevation.depth: whitespace, pale surfaces, image scale, and small structural lines

dos: Use one wide sans typeface at weight 400.
Keep visible type small and uppercase where practical.
Let product photography dominate the composition.
Use bottom navigation with circular indicators.
Keep product cards zero-padded and almost frameless.
donts: Do not add a colored CTA or brand accent.
Do not use large marketing hero headlines.
Do not use shadows or gradients.
Do not use rounded ecommerce cards.
Do not use multiple typefaces or font weights.
Do not decorate with icons, illustrations, or loud badges.
